rates.merchants: United tickets, upgrades, Economy Plus, inflight, bag fees
rates.note: Bought from United. Excludes third-party travel packages, some discount sites, United Cruises, Merchandise Awards.

rates.merchants: Renowned Hotels and Resorts for United Cardmembers
rates.note: Via Chase Travel; prepaid hotel stays. FROSCH bookings do not qualify.
All other travel, excluding United purchases at 4X.

benefits.name: United travel credit
benefits.notes: $200 United TravelBank cash each cardmember anniversary.

benefits.name: Renowned Hotels credit
benefits.notes: Statement credit for prepaid Renowned Hotels and Resorts stays booked through United Hotels; resets each cardmember year.

benefits.name: Rideshare credit
benefits.notes: Up to $8/month in statement credits on rideshare purchases ($12 in December, $100/yr total); opt in every calendar year.

benefits.name: Instacart credit
benefits.notes: Two Instacart credits each month ($10 + $5) in your Instacart account with an active Instacart+ membership (3 months free, then 50% off).

benefits.name: Avis / Budget credit
benefits.notes: Paid as United TravelBank cash: $40 on each of the first two Avis/Budget rentals booked via mileageplustravel.united.com per cardmember year.

benefits.name: JSX credit
benefits.notes: Statement credit on flights booked directly with JSX; resets each cardmember year.

benefits.name: Award flight discount
benefits.notes: 10,000-mile award flight discount deposited after each cardmember anniversary (starting with the first); expires 12 months after issue.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.notes: Up to $120 statement credit for the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee, once every 4 years.

benefits.name: Free checked bags
benefits.notes: First and second standard checked bags free for the primary cardmember and one companion on the same reservation (United/United Express-operated flights; ticket bought with the card, MileagePlus number on the reservation).

benefits.name: Spend award flight discount
benefits.notes: 10,000-mile award flight discount after $20,000 in purchases in a calendar year (one per year); expires 12 months after issue.

benefits.name: 1,000 Card Bonus PQP
benefits.notes: 1,000 Premier qualifying points posted within ~8 weeks of February 1 each year, starting the calendar year after account opening (account must be open on Dec 31 of the prior year).

benefits.name: Economy Plus upgrades
benefits.notes: 2 global Economy Plus seat upgrades after $40,000 in purchases in a calendar year; valid 12 months.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar month if DashPass was first activated 9/1/2026-12/31/2027 (quarterly if first activated 2/1/2025-8/31/2026), while enrolled in DashPass via the card. Source: DoorDash Chase co-brand terms (help.doordash.com); the United card page does not mention DashPass.

benefits.name: 25% back on inflight
benefits.notes: 25% statement credit on food, beverage and Wi-Fi purchases on United/United Express flights and on premium drinks at United Clubs.

benefits.name: DashPass membership
benefits.notes: 12 months of complimentary DashPass when first activated with the card by 12/31/2027, then auto-renews at the paid rate until cancelled. Source: DoorDash Chase co-brand terms; the United card page does not mention DashPass.
